name: Polymarket
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market on Polygon for real-world events.
description: A decentralized prediction market platform that enables individuals to speculate on the outcomes of future real-world events. Built on the Polygon blockchain, it offers transparent, peer-to-peer trading across politics, sports, and economics.

name: Kalshi
shortDescription: First federally regulated event contract exchange in the US.
description: The first federally regulated exchange in the United States dedicated specifically to trading on the outcome of real-world events. Regulated by the CFTC, Kalshi allows users to purchase 'event contracts' on everything from economic indicators to entertainment results.

name: Predict
shortDescription: Blast-native prediction market with yield-generating positions. Acquired Probable in March 2026.
description: A Blast-native prediction market leveraging Layer 2 capabilities to offer yield on positions. Users can trade on politics, sports, and crypto while earning native yield and points towards potential airdrops. In March 2026, Predict.fun acquired Probable, expanding its reach on BNB Chain.

name: Limitless
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market with daily outcome payouts built on Base.
description: A decentralized prediction market platform built on the Base network that allows users to trade binary yes/no contracts on the outcome of future events. Limitless differentiates itself with short-term fast price markets, daily payouts, and instant settlements with no liquidation risk or hidden fees.

name: Probable
shortDescription: Crypto-native prediction platform on BNB Chain with zero trading fees. Acquired by Predict.fun in March 2026.
description: A crypto-native, zero-fee prediction platform built on the BNB Chain using a CLOB trading system and UMA-based settlement. Probable Markets offers frictionless deposits and withdrawals, enabling users to forecast outcomes across crypto, sports, and global events. NOTE: Probable was acquired by Predict.fun in March 2026 and its users migrated to the Predict.fun platform.

name: PizzINT.watch
shortDescription: Real-Time Military Tension Indicator.
description: The Pentagon Pizza Index (PizzINT) tracks real-time pizza shop popularity around the Pentagon as an unconventional OSINT indicator of military activity. Monitor the Pizza DEFCON level and discover when unusual activity might be brewing.

name: Prediction Hunt
shortDescription: Compare Odds Across Every Platform.
description: Compare prediction market odds across Kalshi, Polymarket, PredictIt, and ProphetX. Live arbitrage alerts and cross-platform price comparison.

name: ProbEx
shortDescription: Real-time prediction markets intelligence with AI-powered news analysis.
description: An intelligence dashboard that tracks live odds from Kalshi and Polymarket, enhanced with AI-powered news analysis to provide context for market movements.

name: Predict Shark Analytics

With intuitive UI, smart trend analysis, and lightning-fast execution, it brings the full power of the leading decentralized prediction market to your fingertips.

name: The Trade Fox

description: An aggregator and prime brokerage solution offering unified access to multiple prediction markets. The platform provides advanced trading tools, leverage options, and aggregated insights designed specifically for serious professional traders and institutional use.

description: A comprehensive professional trading interface and the dominant Discord bot for prediction market communities. It provides advanced market views with transaction analysis, an integrated news terminal built specifically for prediction markets with text-to-speech alerts, and a deep UMA dashboard that tracks unrevealed voters and disputed markets. As the official bot provider for Polymarket, Betmoar seamlessly integrates the trading experience directly into Discord servers.
